command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command '$ns=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_03/nodes" -Method Get); foreach($n in $ns){ $u1="http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_03/nodes/"+$n.node_id+"/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration"; $u0="http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf/nodes/"+$n.node_id+"/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration"; $a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $u1 -Method Get).output -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object {$_ -notmatch "^!Last configuration"}; $b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $u0 -Method Get).output -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object {$_ -notmatch "^!Last configuration"}; $d=Compare-Object -ReferenceObject $b -DifferenceObject $a; if($d){ Write-Output ("=== "+$n.node_id+" ==="); $d | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output } }'
